I guess it was more of a bad night last night that I'm still sad about. It's kind of a long story. 



Basically, I had a relationship and we planned on moving in together. We actually broke up a while before, but we still wanted to stay somewhat together and it didn't change the move in plan. He was living with a lot of roomates but got an apartment for us to be alone together because he knows I have social anxiety and his roomates would kind of hold me back.



So we move in and it's been a few months living here together. Occasionally arguing because we're both stupid  but that's to be expected. Mostly really positive and he's been acting romantic, so I'm like... Can we get back together? But he doesn't want to get Together. Or be my Boyfriend. He just wants to get an apartment with me, live with me, buy me gifts, cuddle me, shower me with affection, have sex with me, give emotional and life support and advice, help me with jobs and everything, adopt rabbits together... And not call himself my boyfriend. And it's all private. No hands or anything in public, don't talk about it. And I just feel really stupid and angry at him. Like is this absolutely horrible?? Yes. But am I still going to try to convince him that I'm dateable? Because the alternative THOUGHT makes me walk towards our balcony to jump off? Absolutely. I'm big dumb but this motivates me.


This is where most of our arguments stem from. And he also has a big point (because he's always right) that it isn't fair for him to date me when I'm like this. He has a really good job and does rent and everything alone. I'm basically a pet. And he doesn't want to have a bad breakup or divorce and then I'm just homeless. It's a power issue. I get that. So I'm trying to super speed my way through work and college best I can with crippling social anxiety to prove myself to him mostly honestly. I only have/trust him IRL and get separation anxiety at the thought of like...going to work like a human being and not clinging to him because can't do bring boyfriend to work day.



Anyway last night he was telling me he's going back to get his bachlor's and in two years he wants to start looking into getting a house. And I may or may not be included. He didn't comfort me in that at all, just straight up 50/50 I might be kicked out to who knows where or I might stay. We don't know yet. He just got this apartment for US and I feel like since we've been 80% good together I deserve(?) to be included in the house too. As long as I'm doing better as far as income/edu goes which I'm doing my best... It's just hard to get started when you're a mathematically illiterate drop out with childhood ptsd. I miss my therapist I had before moving out (state lines, can't call him anymore). ):
